location.settingNote: Located approximately 50 metres from the shore of Llyn Padarn (Llanberis Lake), a 3.2km-long glacial lake up to 30m deep in Padarn Country Park, Llanberis, within Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park. The lake is a Site of Special Scientific Interest. The site shares a building with the Lone Tree Cafe and offers views of Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon) and Dolbadarn Castle.

description.short: Snowdonia Watersports Ltd is a family-run kayak, paddleboard, and open-water kit hire and retail outlet on the shores of Llyn Padarn in Llanberis, Eryri National Park. Established in 2016, it holds an AALA licence for canoeing, kayaking, and stand-up paddleboarding and is described by Visit Wales as North Wales' premier canoe and kayak specialist. Sessions launch from Padarn Country Park, with the Lone Tree Cafe on site and views of Snowdon and Dolbadarn Castle as a backdrop.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum age for kit hire?
faqs.a: No stated minimum age; the smallest wetsuit fits an average 5-year-old. A supervising adult (18+) must be present.
No — kit hire is self-guided. The operator states there are no safety patrols, lifeguards, or instructors on the water during hire sessions.
Pets are allowed on kayaks and SUPs at the customer's risk; no pet safety equipment is provided.

faqs.q: Is there a launch fee at Llyn Padarn?
faqs.a: No launch fee for private/recreational paddlers on Llyn Padarn.
